title: Have this in gray from a year ago and love the design
text: Have this in gray from a year ago and love the design. Have this in gray from a year ago and love the design. It is mid weight and stood up well to use and washing.. so recently ordered it again...in blue gray. Big mistake! It smelled so strongly of formaldehyde after 4 washes...that I just threw it out. Anyone who has sensitive skin or is chemically sensitive should avoid this product.
